react.description: A modal `<dialog data-ok-lightbox>` (or an inline carousel with `inline`) around a Carousel of the slides, with a toolbar (zoom, rotate, slideshow, fullscreen, download, share, captions and thumbnails toggles, counter, close), navigation buttons and thumbnails. Behavior is core's `createLightboxController`, which also writes the state into the DOM. Put `LightboxTrigger`s among the children to open it.
